disclaimer: Distances, prices and response times are rough real-world approximations for teaching.

rttMs.note: Round trip between regions over the backbone, approx. Same region is 1 ms across zones.

sim.note: One tick is 10 simulated seconds. At 1x one simulated hour plays in 6 wall seconds, so a full day takes 144 s and one tick lands on each 60 fps frame.

curves.note: 24 hourly multipliers of peak load, hour 0 = midnight in the problem's first region. The engine interpolates linearly between hours.
curves.deadline: computed: base consumer-evening scaled by 0.4, then a linear climb to 1.0 at params.deadlineAt, then 0.1
curves.drop: computed: flat 0.1 with the drop handled by a flash-crowd event at params.dropAt

ttlHitAdjust.note: Change to an element's default hitRate by TTL, clamped to 0.2..0.99.

response.note: How long problems take to notice and fix. Detection uses the fastest detector present; repair is reduced by each speedup present (multiplied).

complianceChecks.text: Data is encrypted with keys held in a key service.

complianceChecks.text: Sensitive personal data lives in one controlled place.

complianceChecks.text: Every store that holds customer data is backed up.

scoring.reliability: 400 x clamp(1 - missNines / 2, 0, 1), where missNines = max(0, log10((1 - actual) / (1 - target))). One nine short scores 200, two nines short scores 0.
scoring.latency: 200 x the traffic-weighted share of simulated minutes whose p99 met the target for interactive types, times the share of requests served. A type's target is its own entry, else the larger of the problem default and the type's natural budget.
scoring.safety: Start at 200. Minus 100 if any acknowledged durable write was lost under a 'no-loss' requirement (minus 40 under 'rpo-1m' if more than 1 minute of writes was lost). Minus 50 if any duplicate non-idempotent request (payment, message, notify, sync, write, webhook) went through. Minus 30 if stale reads exceeded 1 percent where 'read-your-writes' is required. Minus 40 per failed compliance check. Floor 0.
scoring.cost: 200 if monthly cost is at or under budget; falls linearly to 0 at 2 times budget. Safety and cost points are also multiplied by the share of requests served, so a design that serves nothing scores nothing.
scoring.pass: availability at or above target AND latency share at least 0.95 with every interactive type at least 0.8 AND safety at least 150 with no lost write beyond the data-safety rule, no duplicate, no failed compliance check and no stale reads over 1 percent where read-your-writes is required AND cost at or under budget.
